name: Lying Neck Curl
steps: Lie faceup on a flat bench with your shoulders at the edge and your head and neck resting freely beyond the pad.
Keep your upper back flat on the bench and allow your head to lower gently into a comfortable neutral position.
Curl your chin smoothly down toward your chest by flexing your neck under strict control.
Lower your head slowly back to the starting position without letting it drop abruptly backward.
tips: Move slowly through a comfortable, pain-free range without jerking your head upward.
Keep your shoulder blades resting flat on the bench so movement stays strictly at your neck.
